snippet.title: Doom 2: Dimension of the Boomed - MAP02 Blight Wharf - All Secrets
snippet.description:
No commentary playthrough of the Doom 2 addon "Dimension of the Boomed". Showing All secrets, pistol start, Ultra-Violence difficulty.

Dimension of the Boomed is a 7 level pack for Doom2 created by Urthar, as you might've guessed, they are Quake inspired. It also includes new enemies. Great Quality mod!
---------------
Playthrough sin comentar del addon para Doom2 "Dimension of the Boomed". Enseñando todos los secretos, empezando con pistola, dificultad Ultra-Violence.

Dimension of the Boomed es un pack de 7 niveles para Doom2 creado por Urthat, como imaginareis, están inspirados en Quake. También incluye nuevos enemigos. De altísima calidad!
